message.content:
You are fixing Kotlin compilation errors in a Java-to-Kotlin migration project at /Users/admin/project/analysis-danuri.

The Rule*.kt files have many compilation errors, mostly "Unresolved reference" for ProductNameTokenizer constants and methods.

Steps:
1. Read the original Java files and current Kotlin files:
   - src/main/java/com/danawa/search/analysis/product/rule/RuleOne.java → src/main/kotlin/.../RuleOne.kt (45 errors)
   - src/main/java/com/danawa/search/analysis/product/rule/RuleTwo.java → src/main/kotlin/.../RuleTwo.kt (9 errors)
   - src/main/java/com/danawa/search/analysis/product/rule/RuleThree.java → src/main/kotlin/.../RuleThree.kt (15 errors)
   - src/main/java/com/danawa/search/analysis/product/rule/RuleFour.java → src/main/kotlin/.../RuleFour.kt (32 errors)
   - src/main/java/com/danawa/search/analysis/product/rule/RuleFive.java → src/main/kotlin/.../RuleFive.kt (35 errors)
   - Also read src/main/kotlin/com/danawa/search/analysis/product/rule/Rule.kt and RuleEntry.kt for context
2. Read errors: `cat /tmp/kotlin_errors.txt | grep 'Rule[A-Z]'`
3. Read ProductNameTokenizer.kt companion object (constants: ALPHA, NUMBER, SYMBOL, UNIT, HANGUL, etc., methods: getType, getTermType, getUniType, containsChar, isAlphaNum, etc.)
4. Check the CharVector.kt class for methods like charAt, length, offset, etc.
5. Fix ALL issues in each Rule*.kt file

Common error patterns:
- "Unresolved reference 'ALPHA'" etc → Already imported via ProductNameTokenizer.*, verify import is correct
- "Unresolved reference 'getType'" → Companion object method, accessible via wildcard import from ProductNameTokenizer
- "Unresolved reference 'containsChar'" → Same
- "Unresolved reference 'isAlphaNum'" → Same
- "Unresolved reference 'getTermType'" → Same  
- "Unresolved reference 'getUniType'" → Same
- "Unresolved reference 'PTN_NUMBER'" → Same (val in companion)
- "Unresolved reference 'isNotEmpty'" → Check if it's used on CharVector which may not have it
- CharVector.charAt(i) → CharVector may need array() access instead
- Null safety

IMPORTANT: Write complete corrected files for ALL five Rule files. Do not leave any errors.
